crossrefs.text: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.

Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of Godʼs work, which is by faith.
But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
